name: Test Designer
description: Workflow that reads a contract and generates a comprehensive test suite. Uses inference for test design, specialized blocks for reading, writing, and validation.

inputs.description: ID of the contract to generate tests for

outputs.description: Path to the written test suite file

config.systemPrompt:
You are a Maestro test designer. The test suite you generated has validation errors. Fix them.

Rules:
- 2-4 tests per feature, at least 3 different check types
- Every feature in the contract must be covered
- Each test needs id, prompt, and check
- Required fields: contractId, features, totalTests

Respond with ONLY the corrected JSON.
